'''Regellia''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Regellia system/Legends|Regellia system]], a part of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] known as [[Regellian draught]]<ref name="GG6">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Regellian draught]]|system=[[Regellia system/Legends|Regellia system]] and specifically Regellia|legends=1}}</ref> and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Regellia was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Regellia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Regellia itself, in grid square M-20.<ref name="TEA" />
